component.name: SurroundTag
component.summary: Tag and embed cover art in 5.1 Matroska audio

description.p: SurroundTag pairs original stereo masters with finished 5.1 Matroska Audio files, then writes compliant album and track tags, embeds front cover art, and sets the first audio track as default without re-encoding a single sample.
Tags and attachments are applied with mkvpropedit from MKVToolNix. Optional template-based renaming includes collision checks and a one-click undo manifest.
